headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and widget titles. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all standard text, form labels, and data tables.

mono.usage: Use for IDs, code snippets, or specific data values requiring alignment.

rules: Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for card backgrounds.
Use off-white (#F8F9FA) for the main dashboard background to create separation.
Primary color (#0055FF) is for Primary Actions ONLY (Create Survey, Save).
Text must be high contrast (Slate 900 for headings, Slate 600 for body).
Avoid gradients. Use solid, bold colors.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.

grid_system.dashboard: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap-6.
grid_system.survey_list: List View: Single column, wide cards.

layout.shadows: Minimal. shadow-sm for cards. shadow-md for dropdowns/modals. No large diffuse shadows.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2.5
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2.5

cards.style: bg-white border border-border rounded-md shadow-sm p-6. Header must be distinct.

inputs.style: bg-white border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-md h-10 px-3

navigation.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, bg-white border-r border-border. Links: text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-secondary/50 rounded-md px-3 py-2 transition-colors.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the sidebar or specific hero sections (optional).
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React. Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Color: CurrentColor.

login_hero.alt: Abstract geometric shapes representing data structure
login_hero.usage: Split screen login page, right side cover image.

dashboard_empty_state.usage: Use when no surveys exist yet.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard analytics.
Use Recharts or Chart.js (via react-chartjs-2) for data visualization. Match the color palette defined above.
Ensure all forms use 'react-hook-form' with 'zod' validation.
Strictly follow the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' aesthetic. No blurry gradients.
Authentication pages should use a split layout (Form Left, Image Right).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects sparingly (only for sticky headers/overlays).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
